title: Characteristic of Play: Comparison Between Children With Development Coordination Disorder ( DCD) and Children With Typical Development
brief_summary: There will be found differences in the issue of characteristic of play between Children with Development Coordination Disorder and Children with Typical Development.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children with proper( age expected) intelligence and IQ level
* Study in regular education system
* The DCD diagnosis must be confirmed by a pediatrician

Exclusion Criteria:

* Score above 9 in the Movement Assessment Battery test for Children
* Score below 3.83 in Children Activity Scale for Parents
* routinely take medication
* any physical limitations
* neurologic and/or muscle disease
* any significant hearing and/ or vision limitations
study_population: Children aged 4-6 years with Development Coordination Disorder ( DCD) and Children with Typical Development (controlled group)
